purpose: Read the exact selected authenticated catalog image as bounded uninspected bytes; first prerequisite for future immutable merchant preview assets. No client-provided URL fetch authority.
limits: Only exact cdn.shopify.com/public IPv4 and declared PNG/JPEG/SVG are supported initially; other Shopify CDN hosts/IPv6/WebP/AVIF fail explicitly. No URL rewrite or buyer-artwork policy change.

A successful read or supported MIME does not establish inspection, immutable storage, revision binding, merchant-owned reference/cleanup lifecycle or historical preview acceptance. Those paths are not composed yet.
Caller supplies a current authenticated tenant/product catalog result; this adapter does not authenticate a merchant by itself.

Native observation used the reviewed compiled candidate in an ephemeral Node process in the existing web container network, not a deployed application route or new image. No deployed composition claim.
Abort settles the caller and suppresses late dispatch; the outstanding OS DNS lookup itself cannot be cancelled.
